target_customer: Developer and API product companies that need usage-based billing and API key management
problem: API companies must build metering, billing, invoicing and auth themselves before they can charge by usage.
business_model: Usage-based pricing on events stored and revenue generated

founders.name: Adam Sommer
education: Duke University, Computer Science and Public Policy
founders.background_notes: YC page: 5 years as billing lead at Hulu. Launch HN post adds two years leading security at Appian and earlier WePay (YC S09). A CB Insights profile also lists UBS and Artsicle, unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Event metering, invoicing and key management with a three line SDK is standard but needs reliability for billing correctness.

defensibility.rationale: Billing data and integration create some lock-in but features are copyable by Stripe and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe later added metered billing and in January 2026 completed its acquisition of Metronome, a rival; no acquisition of Kable found.

market_need_then: Launch HN post says API-first companies need billing tooling that exists only in fragments; no spend data found.

branding.domain_note: kable.io; the domain later redirected to a GoDaddy for-sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; the name is similar to other firms named Kable or Cable.

outcome_analysis: The cause of the inactive status is not public: no shutdown post, post-mortem or press report was found. Kable raised a seed round of about $2.65 million soon after YC W22 and sold into a market that Stripe and Metronome then pressed from above, but no source ties its inactive status to a cause. The kable.io domain now redirects to a for-sale listing, consistent with the company having stopped.
notes: Seed of $2.65M announced April 28, 2022 with Matrix Partners as lead is stated on the YC page; a search found no second source naming Matrix, and aggregators name Y Combinator only. The $275K pre-seed (Nov 2021) came from one aggregator in the search results and I could not confirm which; attributed to employbl, treat as single-database. CB Insights lists $500K and a convertible note, conflicting. Competitor list empty: the Launch HN post names no rivals and no dated rival sources were found. Exit type unknown. Status of the dead domain: kable.io redirected to a GoDaddy for-sale page.
